## Implement PairLoom package for pair-aware BAM realignment and merging

```
level: high
date: 2026-10-21
```

### description

Implement a production-quality Python package (CLI `pairmerge`) that adjusts paired-end BAM alignments repeat-aware and deterministically, optimizes joint R1/R2 placement, applies conservative MAPQ policy, reports overlapping-base disagreements and template classifications as Parquet, and optionally merges overlapping mates into consensus records with correct CIGARs and preserved outer soft clips — with explicit per-output CLI paths, memory-bounded statistics, deterministic parallelism, and fail-loud error handling throughout.

### result

1. Implemented installable `pairloom` package (src layout, hatchling, pixi workspace) with `pairmerge` CLI covering both modes and all specified parameters.
2. Implemented repeat-aware candidate discovery, joint pair optimization with the documented preference hierarchy and two strategies, and conservative MAPQ policy with corroboration requirement.
3. Implemented CIGAR-aware overlap analysis with the exact disagreement Parquet schema, strand-aware counting, and memory-bounded spilling aggregation.
4. Implemented classification + configurable BAM tagging with collision policy, and consensus merging with CIGAR reconstruction and outer soft clips.
5. Implemented streaming pipeline with atomic publish, output-integrity rollback, and deterministic worker parallelism whose failures propagate.
6. Answered spec §15 ambiguity list with documented defaults in README; established record policy (non-primary passthrough, orphan normalization).
7. Fixed three bugs found during testing: reverse-strand SAM orientation, one-mate-deleted indel conflicts, independent mate sliding in fallback.

### change

Files:
- Created: `pyproject.toml`, `README.md`, `src/pairloom/{__init__,exceptions,config,cigarops,reference,alignment,candidates,pairing,mapq,records,overlap,classify,merge,parquetout,validate,pipeline,cli}.py`
- Created: `tests/{conftest,test_cigarops,test_pairing,test_candidates_mapq,test_disagreement,test_merge,test_classify_policy,test_cli,test_errors,test_integration}.py` (120 tests)
- Created: `benchmarks/benchmark.py`, `benchmarks/results/`, `scripts/build_synthetic_dataset.py`, `data/synthetic/*`
- Created: `docs/plans/20261021-110836_pairloom-implementation.{plan,report}.qmd`, `docs/misc/requirements_audit.qmd`, `docs/misc/next_and_recommendation.qmd`
- Updated: `pixi.toml`, `pixi.lock`, `.gitignore`

Packages: `pysam>=0.24.1, pyarrow>=25, numpy>=2.5, python>=3.12,<3.14 -> pixi:default (conda); pairloom (editable) -> pixi:default (pypi); pytest, pytest-timeout, ruff, samtools, pip -> pixi:default (dev feature)`

## Evaluate third-party review findings before fixing

```
level: high
date: 2026-10-21
```

### description

Assess six third-party code-review findings (two MAPQ overstatement bugs, spill-merge memory bound, trailing-clip selection, orphan mate coordinates, index overwrite validation) against the actual code with independent reproductions, then propose an agreement position and wait for user confirmation before implementing.

### result

1. Answered: all six findings independently verified by code reading and end-to-end reproductions; none refuted.
2. Answered: both MAPQ bugs confirmed — merged consensus carries 60 on the repeat pair (committed expected outputs encode it); `--max-pair-evaluations 1` yields 60 at an ambiguous placement.
3. Answered: spill finalize measured at 8.7 MB peak for 60k positions with a 1000-entry bound (linear in dataset size, violates the documented memory guarantee).
4. Answered: contained-mate merge emits 40M2S instead of 40M3S; orphan unmapped mate keeps stale RNEXT 416 after movement to 400; existing `.bai` overwritten without `--force`.
5. Answered: one extra item found — `single_read_ambiguity` in `src/pairloom/pairing.py` is dead code with no callers.

## Apply the six confirmed review fixes

```
level: high
date: 2026-10-21
```

### description

After the user confirmed the evaluation verdict, implement all six verified fixes (consensus MAPQ policy, bounded spill finalize, pair-evaluation truncation flag, trailing-clip ownership, orphan RNEXT, index validation) plus the dead-code cleanup, with regression tests, regenerated synthetic expected outputs, and documentation in sync.

### result

1. Implemented consensus MAPQ = min(adjusted mate MAPQs); eligibility unchanged on original aligner MAPQ (try_merge merged_mapq parameter).
2. Implemented lazy spill streams with bounded merge fan-in (cascading re-spills at 16) and batched spill writing; finalize memory now configuration-bounded.
3. Implemented pair-evaluation truncation propagation into PairChoice.truncated; capped searches now yield min(orig, 10), never 60.
4. Implemented trailing-clip ownership by largest aligned end; contained mates keep the container's outer clip (40M3S case).
5. Implemented unmapped-mate RNEXT/PNEXT refresh after mapped-mate movement.
6. Implemented `<bam>.bai` index destinations in preflight validation (existence requires --force; collisions rejected).
7. Refactored: removed dead `single_read_ambiguity`; regenerated synthetic expected outputs; updated README and EXPECTED.md; re-measured benchmark (no regression).

## Apply the five confirmed second-round review fixes

```
level: high
date: 2026-10-21
```

### description

After the user confirmed the second evaluation verdict, implement the five verified fixes (stale-tag removal, publish backup/restore under --force, clip-owner tie rules, secondary-only passthrough, intersection-only overlap fetch) plus the symmetric lead-clip tie gap and the temp-registration leak, with regression tests and documentation in sync.

### result

1. Implemented stale-tag removal via set_tag(tag, None) — moved reads with aligner tags (AS/XS/MQ) no longer crash; pysam has no remove_tag.
2. Implemented publish backup/restore: existing outputs move aside before replacement, restored on failure — a failed --force run never destroys previous results.
3. Implemented _lead_owner/_trail_owner: outer-clip owners by aligned extent, ties toward the longer supported clip on both ends.
4. Implemented primary-less template passthrough as neither_aligned, untagged and unadjusted, in both modes.
5. Implemented intersection-only reference fetching for overlap analysis; distant mates no longer allocate the inter-mate span.
6. Refactored: +7 regression tests (137 total); README record policy, clip tie rule, publish integrity, and memory paragraphs updated; benchmark re-measured (unchanged).

## Apply the four confirmed fifth-round review fixes

```
level: high
date: 2026-10-21
```

### description

After the user confirmed the fifth evaluation verdict (with '='-expansion before discovery and the orientation-model tie rule), implement the four verified fixes with regression tests and documentation in sync.

### result

1. Implemented CIGAR normalization in build_read_structure: adjacent identical ops no longer overwrite each other at a shared boundary (10M2I3I10M merges to 10M5I10M).
2. Implemented '=' SEQ shorthand expansion against the reference (no-op without '='); pysam's query_sequence setter dropping query_qualities was found by the new test and fixed by restoring them.

5. Refactored: +4 regression tests (151 total); README and AGENTS.md updated (invariant 9, test count); benchmark A/B under machine load ~10 showed no code regression (post 8.7-9.4 s vs pre 9.0 s).
